title: Cement emission forecasting under data scarcity and heterogeneity (code and results)
description: Code, automated leakage tests and results for the paper 'Neural Basis Expansion for Cement Emission Forecasting Under Data Scarcity and Heterogeneity'. Includes a leakage-controlled forecasting framework for national cement process CO2 emissions built on neural basis expansion (N-BEATS), twelve comparison models, provenance-stratified conformal prediction intervals, a deployable forecaster with a model card, and the outputs of the run reported in the paper. The GCP-CEM input data (Andrew, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.20397304) are downloaded by a script and not redistributed.
